case_provenance: Synthetic regressions in pinned real libraries; never call them historical bugs.
eligibility: Clean upstream full selected suites pass before injection.
Each case compiles after injection and fails unchanged upstream tests.
Multi-hunk complexity is labelled honestly; independent faults are distinguished from coupled contracts.
Every case uses indirect recent-change context, with no inverse mutation diff or fixture oracle in the model packet.
Development/holdout assignments are frozen before model evaluation.

selection.primary: Most development cases reaching verified native tests, final rebase/retest, exact tested pushed head and one mock PR.
selection.additional_development_changes: Record a new arm/version before running it. Diagnose only development outcomes. Never tune from holdout outcomes.
selection.freeze: Save selected arm, prompt hash, implementation hashes and case manifest hashes before running holdout.

dataset_quality_correction.coupled_contract_exception: Two substitution-pass mutations crash independently but compile and produce assertion failures together; they remain explicitly labelled coupled.

grading.oracle: Actual compilation and full selected upstream suites with unchanged test/configuration files; exact expected patch matching is not required.
metrics: original failing tests present and passing
grading.replays: Mechanical regression checks only; never count them as live model evaluations.
